Quick Reference

Most Used Classes:

  • gigacode.gigacode_tool.CodeEmbeddingTool - Main entry point

  • gigacode.index_manager.IndexManager - Index management

  • gigacode.search_service.SearchService - Search operations

  • gigacode.buffer_manager.BufferManager - Buffer management

Most Used Methods:

  • gigacode.gigacode_tool.CodeEmbeddingTool.embed_codebase() - Embed a project

  • gigacode.gigacode_tool.CodeEmbeddingTool.semantic_search() - Search by meaning

  • gigacode.gigacode_tool.CodeEmbeddingTool.hybrid_search() - Semantic + lexical search

  • gigacode.gigacode_tool.CodeEmbeddingTool.write_code() - Update code

  • gigacode.gigacode_tool.CodeEmbeddingTool.commit() - Commit changes

  • gigacode.gigacode_tool.CodeEmbeddingTool.find_duplicates() - Find similar code

Configuration:

  • See gigacode.operation_config.OperationConfig for all settings

  • Defaults suitable for most projects

  • Tune for your specific needs
